briefings.name: Quick Check
briefings.description: Quick directional read on Bitcoin price and net liquidity with their 30-day correlation

briefings.name: BTC Context
briefings.description: Bitcoin price, mining health, and liquidity overview with 7-day and 30-day trend signals

briefings.name: Macro Snapshot
briefings.description: Fed balance sheet, M2 money supply, full Treasury yield curve (2Y/10Y/30Y), 10Y breakeven inflation, dollar strength (the UUP ETF), and composite net liquidity with trend direction across all four, plus global central-bank balance-sheet overlay (BOJ total assets, ECB total assets, Eurozone M3) for cross-region liquidity context

briefings.name: Correlation Check
briefings.description: How Bitcoin correlates with equities, volatility, and the dollar across 9 metric pairs (30-day window)

briefings.name: BTC Pulse
briefings.description: Quick price action check - price, 24h change, dominance

briefings.name: Grid Stress
briefings.description: Mining network health - block production speed and upcoming difficulty adjustment forecast

briefings.name: BTC Momentum
briefings.description: Multi-timeframe BTC momentum (7d/30d/90d) with percentile rankings, 200-day moving average distance, 24h volume, 30d volume Z-score (confirmation/non-confirmation overlay), hash-rate, dollar strength, net-liquidity backdrop, and BTC perp derivatives positioning (funding rate + open interest)

briefings.name: Liquidity Momentum
briefings.description: Fed balance, Treasury General Account, M2 money supply, composite net liquidity tracking with 7d/30d/90d trend changes and YTD percentile rankings, NY Fed System Open Market Account (SOMA) total holdings, and daily reverse-repo take-up as the collateral-cash imbalance signal

briefings.name: On-Chain Health
briefings.description: Bitcoin network deep-dive - hash rate, difficulty, transaction count, volume, and active addresses with trends

briefings.name: Market Breadth
briefings.description: Risk appetite across S&P 500, Nasdaq, and small caps with Bitcoin correlation for each

briefings.name: Miner Survival Index
briefings.description: Miner profitability check - revenue per hash, production cost tiers, and stress signals

briefings.name: Full Context
briefings.description: Full Bitcoin analysis - price, macro overlay, momentum, percentiles, correlations, and narrative text

briefings.name: Factor Attribution
briefings.description: Rule-based "why is Bitcoin moving" with contributing macro factors (Fed balance, TGA, net liquidity, dollar), on-chain factors (hash rate, volume), BTC perp derivatives positioning (funding rate + open interest), and 30-day ATM implied volatility as a regime signal

briefings.name: Regime Check
briefings.description: Market regime classification (risk-on, risk-off, accumulation, distribution) with divergence alerts, stablecoin sentiment, central-bank policy spreads, and global central-bank balance-sheet overlay (BOJ total assets, Eurozone M3, Germany 10Y Bund)

briefings.name: FX Liquidity
briefings.description: Dollar and currency environment - EUR/USD, CNY/USD direction with net liquidity correlation

briefings.name: Energy Cost Index
briefings.description: Mining economics - production cost model, natural gas input costs, and energy margin pressure

briefings.name: Treasury Holdings Intelligence
briefings.description: Corporate Bitcoin treasury holdings - accumulation trends from SEC filings and CoinGecko

briefings.name: BTC ETF Flows
briefings.description: Spot BTC ETF flow read: net daily flows, aggregate AUM (sourced from per-issuer pages), and per-issuer breakdown across iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC), Grayscale Bitcoin Trust (GBTC), and other approved spot ETFs
